title: First deploy of web and API
author: pratos with Claude Code
summary: Push to main and the live Workers change, with a version label anyone can read and a version id to roll back to. A migration stays a separate, deliberate act: a deploy with one pending stops before it touches anything.
current: cp-00 runs two Workers locally, joined by the `API` binding, with `/healthz` and `/readyz` on both, the D1 binding, the recipes, the lint boundary, skills, hooks and the map. Nothing is deployed, so every label reads `dev`.
discoveries: `wrangler d1 migrations list --remote` fails without D1 access; `scripts/deploy.sh` treats that as a stop, because unknown is not none.
`wrangler deploy --var GIT_DESCRIBE:<label>` sets the label per deploy; the `VERSION` metadata binding already supplies the id rollback needs.
`wrangler versions upload --tag pr-<n>` uploads a version that takes no traffic, which is how a pull request gets a preview.
The API deploys before the web Worker, so the binding's target exists; the web Worker needs `bun run build` first.
The smoke check reads `greenhouse-api.<subdomain>.workers.dev/healthz`; the subdomain differs per Cloudflare account, hence the `WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN` variable.
endState: A push to main runs `check`, then deploys api then web; the live `/healthz` shows the `git describe` label. `just rollback api <id>` returns to the previous version. A pending migration stops `just deploy`.
notDoing: Migrating on deploy; migrations are applied by hand, locally or by the manual workflow.
Feature flags; `docs/RELEASE.md` names the flag step, and its commands arrive later.
A staging environment; the script passes `--env`, but none is configured.
Custom domains; both Workers stay on workers.dev.
approach: Script first, so a laptop and CI deploy the same way. Then the workflow that calls it. Then the docs a newcomer follows for the first deploy and for every rollback after.

decisions.question: When do migrations run?

options.label: By hand; deploy stops if one is pending

decisions.why: A migration changes data a rollback cannot undo, so it gets its own reading and its own click. Deploy only checks for one, so rolled-back code never meets a schema it does not know.

steps.caption: The deploy first asks D1 which migrations are still pending.
One is pending, so the deploy stops and changes nothing.
A person reads the migration and applies it on purpose.
The next deploy finds nothing pending and ships api, then web.
The deploy applies every pending migration without anyone reading it.
The code rolls back, but the schema stays changed underneath it.

phases.name: Deploy script: refuse, deploy, smoke
phases.goal: `just deploy` stops on a pending migration or any failure, deploys api then web labelled by `git describe`, and checks the live `/healthz`.

changes.intent: Exit 0 only when every step passed; print the lines a person needs.

contract.code:
# just deploy [env]
wrangler d1 migrations list greenhouse --remote   # fails, or lists any NNNN_ → exit 1, nothing deployed
label="$(git describe --tags --always --dirty)"
(cd apps/api && wrangler deploy --var "GIT_DESCRIBE:$label")
(cd apps/web && bun run build && wrangler deploy --var "GIT_DESCRIBE:$label")
curl -sf "https://greenhouse-api.$WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev/healthz" | jq -e '.ok and .version'

changes.intent: Three recipes; none of them migrates as a side effect.
The real `database_id` of the remote `greenhouse` D1 database.

manual.text: Add a throwaway migration; `just deploy` stops, lists it, and deploys nothing.

phases.notes: The probe: `cd apps/api && bunx wrangler d1 migrations create greenhouse probe`, run `just deploy`, then delete the file.

phases.name: GitHub Actions: check, preview, deploy, migrate
phases.goal: Every push and PR runs `check`; a PR uploads preview versions; a push to main deploys through the same script; migrating is a manual run.

changes.intent: Four jobs; `deploy` and `migrate` run in the `production` environment.

contract.code:
on: { push: { branches: [main] }, pull_request: {}, workflow_dispatch: {} }
jobs:
  check:   # every run: frozen install, lint, tests, arch check, wrangler types diff,
           # and no drop or rename migration without ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE in the message
  preview: # pull_request, needs check: wrangler versions upload --tag pr-<n>, api then web
  deploy:  # push to main, needs check: scripts/deploy.sh with vars.WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN
  migrate: # workflow_dispatch only: d1 migrations list, then apply --remote
